_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_plot.py. t_lilah is Lilah, Undefeated Slickshot's second line. t_gold_bolt is a multicolored instant and t_mono_bolt the mono-coloured near miss, which is what separates `min_colors` from `colors`. t_plotter and t_plotted_bear print Plot themselves: an instant, so "only as a sorcery" has something to restrict, and a creature with no other text. t_plot_discounter is Doc Aurlock, Grizzled Genius's second line, for tests/unit/casting/test_plot_cost_reduction.py.

cards.name: Test Slickshot
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a multicolored instant or sorcery spell from your hand, exile that spell instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves. If you do, it becomes plotted.
